name: manual_49a5af
claim: On Mac when Ollama is warm and LM Studio is passive-only, route Mac co-orchestrator and subagent inference through ollama-mac at localhost:11434. LM Studio :1234 may still answer peer-lmstudio probes with a model catalog but must not be the primary execution path unless hardware policy requires MLX on that port.
